The "Building a Healthy Plate" course then focuses on practical food patterns, helping learners apply their knowledge to real-life dietary choices. The "Stanford Introduction to Food and Health" course integrates the learner's knowledge with practical applications in health informatics, food safety, and food science. The "Child Nutrition and Cooking" course provides specific insights into the nutritional needs of children, while the "Nutrition and Lifestyle in Pregnancy" course introduces more advanced topics in nutrition, including the impact of nutrition on pregnancy. This structured progression ensures that the learner builds a comprehensive understanding of nutrition and healthy eating based on solid evidence.
